(03)Why Lumi

Hospital care, without the hospital feeling.

Modern medicine is complicated. Being a patient shouldn't be.

Senior specialists, on time

Consultants see you themselves, and booked slots run to the clock.

Diagnostics under one roof

24/7 lab, CT, MRI and imaging, with reports on your phone.

An emergency team that's always up

Emergency room, ICU and ambulance, staffed around the clock.

Cashless, without the chase

Our insurance desk handles approvals so you don't have to.

(05)Your visit

Four steps. No runaround.

From booking to follow-up, every step is designed to save you time.

Patient guide
01

Book in a minute

Pick a speciality or doctor online, on WhatsApp or by phone. No login needed.

02

Arrive, skip the queue

Your file is ready at the front desk. Pre-booked patients go straight to the doctor's floor.

03

One team, one plan

Specialists, lab and imaging share your records, so you're never repeating your story.

04

Home, not alone

Digital reports, follow-up reminders and a care coordinator you can reach on WhatsApp.
